statement: If A is a set of positive integers such that the sum of the reciprocals of the elements of A diverges, then A contains arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions. This is the Erdos conjecture on arithmetic progressions.
solving_prose: Partial results by Green and Tao for primes; general case open then attributed.

statement: Is it true that for every prime p there exist integers a, b, c with 4/p = 1/a + 1/b + 1/c? This is the Erdos-Straus conjecture on unit fractions.

The Erdos discrepancy problem: for any infinite sequence of plus and minus ones, and any constant C, there exist a step d and length n such that the absolute value of the sum over multiples of d up to n exceeds C.
solving_prose: Proved by Terence Tao in 2015 using the Elliott conjecture on multiplicative functions.

statement: Erdos-Ko-Rado type question: determine the maximum size of a family of k-element subsets of an n-element set such that any two subsets intersect.
Erdos conjectured that the minimum overlap of a partition of the integers up to 2n into two sets of size n grows like a constant times n; the precise constant was conjectured.
solving_prose: Bounds improved; original precise form disproved.

statement: The prime k-tuples conjecture: let H be an admissible set of integers h_1 through h_k; then there are infinitely many integers n such that all of n+h_i are prime.
Every set of n points in general position in the plane contains a subset of roughly log n points in convex position; the Erdos-Szekeres happy ending problem on convex polygons.
solving_prose: Resolved up to constants by Suk 2017.

statement: Erdos unit distance problem: the maximum number of unit distances among n points in the plane is at most n to the power 1+o(1).
Erdos-Ginzburg-Ziv theorem: any 2n-1 integers contain n whose sum is divisible by n.
solving_prose: Classical theorem, formalized in Lean mathlib.

statement: Erdos conjecture on covering systems: the minimum modulus of a covering system of congruences with distinct moduli is bounded.
solving_prose: Hough proved the minimum modulus is bounded (2015), resolving one form.
